de-DE.name: Mein Vorrat (Everyday Runtime)
de-DE.summary: Deine selbst gehostete Einkaufsliste mit Vorratsgedächtnis.
de-DE.description: Sag, was leer ist, was du gekauft hast oder was auf die Liste soll, und frag, was ihr wahrscheinlich braucht. Die Daten bleiben in deinem eigenen Twenty-Workspace mit Everyday Runtime.
examplePhrases: Alexa, sage mein vorrat Milch ist leer
Alexa, frag mein vorrat was brauchen wir

en-US.name: Everyday List (Everyday Runtime)
en-US.summary: Your self-hosted shopping list that remembers what runs out.
en-US.description: Say what ran out, what you bought or what goes on the list, and ask what you probably need. Your data stays in your own Twenty workspace running Everyday Runtime.
examplePhrases: Alexa, tell everyday list we're out of milk
Alexa, ask everyday list what do we need

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Needs a Twenty workspace with Everyday Runtime installed; see docs/ALEXA.md.
